narrow: rounding by symbiont of host cells
related: disruption by symbiont of host cytoskeleton
modification by symbiont of host cytoskeleton

definition: The process in which an organism effects a change that impairs the structure or function of the host cytoskeleton. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated perturbation of host cytoskeleton
